gates.name: Discovery Kick-off
gates.failure: Delivery starts before the sponsor, the team or real users are lined up.

gates.name: Requirements Baseline
gates.failure: Each discipline reads the same requirement differently, and nobody finds out until UAT.

gates.name: Design Authority
gates.failure: The design is approved without security, data or test sign-off.

gates.name: Sprint Planning
gates.failure: Stories enter the sprint without acceptance criteria or finished designs.

gates.name: Definition of Done
gates.failure: "Done" means coded, not tested, secured and documented.

gates.name: Go / No-Go
gates.failure: The decision is driven by the date, not by the evidence.

gates.name: Live Service
gates.failure: The project team leaves before support is ready to take over.

gates.name: Change Control
gates.failure: Hotfixes skip review and quietly become permanent.

gates.name: Decommission
gates.failure: Systems are switched off while data and costs stay live.
